**About us**

At Xelix, we work with some of the world’s largest companies to automate and strengthen their financial controls. Our AI solutions redefine how Accounts Payable teams operate – moving from manual processes to automated, intelligent workflows.

Xelix is a fast-paced scale-up – things move fast and expectations are high. We raised our Series B with Insight Partners in June 2025 and are expanding aggressively. We have a team of over **150** talented people pulling together to achieve our goals. Everyone is trusted to take ownership, move fast and have a meaningful impact. We prioritise personal and professional growth, keep things fun, and love to celebrate a milestone together.

In this role you’ll grow, be challenged and help shape the future of Xelix. If you’re excited about building something special with us, we’d love to hear from you.

**About the role**

At Xelix the DevOps team is responsible for managing, monitoring and optimizing our SaaS platform, i.e. ensuring system Availability, Durability, Reliability, Resiliency and Fault Tolerance. They support and work closely with our in-house developers, providing a world class developer experience.

As Xelix continues to expand, so have the demands on our DevOps team. We are seeking an additional junior DevOps Engineer to help us complete items in our existing tech roadmap and help us hit our targets for the following year. We are looking for someone who can help the team improve our CI/CD processes, automate manual processes to create a self-service environment for our developers, and maintain platform uptime SLAs by improving our observability stack.

We use infrastructure-as-code to maintain our platform on AWS, so familiarity with common AWS Services (RDS, S3, ECS, EC2 etc.) and Terraform is essential for this role.

Xelix handles large volumes of sensitive commercial data, making security crucial across all our activities. In this role you will build on our existing security infrastructure by helping to implement and maintain security best practices.

**What you'll be doing**

* Operating production AWS workloads
* Provision, upgrade and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform
* Release engineering: Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines through Jenkins / Github Actions and other technology
* Support the Development and AI Engineering Teams - help troubleshoot their issues
* Bring observability through dashboards, alerting and log aggregation
* Run incident analysis and post mortems
*

Infinigraph
 and 
Composite

Aura is Neo4j’s fully managed graph database as a service. Customers create, scale, and use Neo4j databases in the cloud without installing, clustering, or operating the database themselves. Aura runs on Kubernetes across Google Cloud, AWS, and Azure, and handles provisioning, networking, security, upgrades, and day-to-day operations for those databases.

Composite is the technology behind distributed query execution in Neo4j: one query can span multiple databases. Those capabilities still have to run as a cloud product, and that's where a large part of this role sits: building the Go services and Kubernetes machinery that provision, scale, and operate sharded and composite clusters on Aura, reliably, at the data volumes our customers keep growing into.

ABOUT GLIMPSE

Glimpse is the leading AI platform for CPG brands — automating critical back-office workflows like deductions management, revenue recovery, and cash application. Since launching in April 2024, we've grown from 0 to 200+ customers, raised $52M from investors including a16z, 8VC and Y Combinator.

We're building the next-generation suite of services for consumer brands and are looking for exceptional people to help us scale.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a Founding Forward Deployment Engineer. You'll sit at the point where customer reality meets our product: messy ERPs, undocumented data, and asks that sound simple until you dig in. You'll turn that ambiguity into working, well-built software. You'll also define what the FDE function looks like as it grows. The integration patterns, validation standards, and ways of working you set up will outlast any single customer.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - Own customer problems end to end. Take a vague customer ask and drive it to a shipped solution without waiting for a spec. Pick up the work nobody assigned when it matters.

 - Find the real problem. Look past what customers literally request to what will actually make them successful. Turn scattered and conflicting feedback into a clear product direction the team can build against.

 - Build data integrations that hold up. Move and reconcile SKU, inventory, transaction, and invoice data across legacy systems and modern data stacks. Handle undocumented sources, partial data, backfills, and idempotent reprocessing as a matter of course.

 - Design patterns that scale. Build integration approaches that work across customers and ERPs, not one-off scripts. Plan for failure modes, scale, and future change before they force your hand.

 - Make correctness a first-class requirement. Build validation, exception handling, and reconciliation into every workflow, especially where AI touches financial data. Know when an AI step shouldn't be used. Help define how Glimpse proves AI-driven outputs to customers and auditors.

 - Set the bar for good code. Write clean, correct software. Use AI dev tools as a core part of how you work. Reason openly about tradeo

The Build & Release team owns the path from source to flight-ready software across growing satellite constellations. A bad update is not a simple rollback, it could mean a satellite becomes at risk.

The role is in the realm of half build engineering and half embedded Linux development, you need to be willing to work at both ends.

Satellites are treated to OTA updates regularly which our team must make sure are built and deployed the right way, utilizing software development best practices.

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.



ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.



ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.



Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Omschrijving

**Cloud & AI Operations | Rapid Circle**

**Run. Improve. Pioneer.**

Een incident oplossen is soms het werk.

**Zorgen dat hetzelfde incident niet nog een keer gebeurt, is waar engineering begint.**

Bij Rapid Circle werk je als Cloud Engineer aan bedrijfskritische Azure- en Microsoft 365-omgevingen. Je lost technische problemen op, voert changes uit en houdt klantomgevingen gezond. Maar daar stopt het niet.

We verwachten dat je verder kijkt.

**Waarom gebeurde dit? Wat kunnen we verbeteren? Wat kunnen we automatiseren? En kunnen we het probleem helemaal wegnemen?**

Dat is hoe wij naar Cloud & AI Operations kijken.

**Wat ga je doen?**

Als Cloud Engineer werk je hands-on met Microsoft-technologie, waaronder **Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, networking, security, Intune en automation**.

De ene dag onderzoek je een complex incident. De volgende dag voer je een change uit, verbeter je monitoring, schrijf je een PowerShell-script of werk je samen met een ervaren engineer aan een structurele verbetering van een klantomgeving.

Je hebt inmiddels voldoende technische ervaring om zelfstandig problemen op te pakken. Tegelijkertijd weet je dat er altijd meer te leren valt. Bij complexe vraagstukken zoek je de samenwerking met collega's, architects en specialisten.

Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je tegenkomt. Niet alleen om een ticket af te sluiten, maar om de omgeving beter achter te laten dan je haar aantrof.

Daarbij werken we steeds meer met **PowerShell, Infrastructure as Code, observability, automation en AI**. Niet omdat ieder probleem een nieuwe tool nodig heeft, maar omdat cloud operations verandert.

Van handmatig reageren naar slimmer beheren.

Van steeds opnieuw oplossen naar structureel verbeteren.

Van terugkerend werk naar automatisering.

Als Cloud Engineer draag je actief bij aan die ontwikkeling. Je herkent terugkerende problemen, denkt mee over verbeteringen en krijgt de ruimte om nieuwe technologieën en werkwijzen in de praktijk toe te passen.

**Die manier van werken bouwen we nu verder uit. En daar kun jij een belangrijke bijdrage aan leveren.**

**Wie ben jij?**

We zoeken een Cloud Engineer die niet tevreden is met:

**"Het werkt weer."**

Je wilt begrijpen waarom iets misging. Je vraagt door wanneer een oplossing niet logisch voelt. Je ziet wanneer een handmatige handeling eigenlijk geautomatiseerd zou moeten worden. En als je ergens niet uitkomt, weet je de juiste collega's te vinden om samen verder te komen.

81ed70b8d1e47fdd.description:
#### **Your creative field**

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Platform & Reliability Engineer (all genders) to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).  
  
As a Platform & Reliability Engineer at Contabo, you take architectural ownership of our shared infrastructure services – the foundation that multiple development teams build on: API gateway and ingress (Kong, Nginx Ingress), persistent storage (Ceph, Longhorn), secrets and identity infrastructure (Vault, Keycloak), edge security and WAF (Cloudflare), and our observability stack. You'll be taking over grown, partially under-documented systems – and that's exactly where the appeal of this role lies: you work your way deep into these systems, identify and remediate known weak points, evaluate aging components with solution-agnostic build-vs-buy reasoning, and decide which legacy pieces get fixed, replaced, or retired.  
  
One of your central mandates: you design and establish an on-call process, including runbooks for platform and infrastructure incidents – where no formal process exists today. In parallel, you mature our observability practices, rolling out distributed tracing, SLOs/SLIs, and meaningful dashboards across the stack, building on our existing tooling with Prometheus, Grafana, Alloy, and OpenTelemetry. In system design reviews, you bring your strong grounding in the fundamentals – load balancing, caching, sharding, replication, consistency trade-offs – and apply them to new and existing services alike.  
  
You won't be managing a team, but you will be the technical authority multiple teams rely on: you advise across teams on shared infrastructure services, document your knowledge consistently, and actively distribute it – so that critical know-how never again depends on a single person. Success in this role means: known risks are resolved, a solid on-call process is up and running, and single points of failure are measurably reduced platform-wide. The position is remote (Germany), with hybrid or on-site work optional; occasional travel for datacenter visits and team offsites is part of the role.

#### **What convinces us**

Your personality, paired with:

  

* 7+ years of experience in platform, infrastructure, or SRE roles, ideally with end-to-end responsibility for a private cloud or IaaS platform

**Who We Are**

You've ordered dinner through Just Eat Takeaway. You've bought and sold on OLX. You've paid with PayU. Chances are, you've already used a Prosus company today.

We are Prosus, a global technology company powering some of the world's leading lifestyle ecommerce businesses. Every day, billions of people across India, Latin America, Europe and beyond use our products and services to buy, sell, pay, connect and discover.

9f0e0a72b503f450.title: DevOps/Platform Engineer
9f0e0a72b503f450.location: Abu Dhabi, AZ, United Arab Emirates
9f0e0a72b503f450.description:
Analog is building the connective tissue between humans, cities, and technology: robots deployed in hospitals, live spatial intelligence for entire cities, holographic sports experiences built with a top motorsport team. None of that ships without infrastructure that just works. We run microservices across half a dozen languages (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, TypeScript) alongside Unity applications powering real-time, spatial experiences, and every one of those teams depends on pipelines that are fast, secure, and boring in the best way. That's where you come in.

**What we're looking for, and why**
-----------------------------------

We're looking for someone who gets genuine satisfaction from making other engineers' lives easier, who'd rather fix the thing that causes five tickets a week than triage each one by hand. As we take on more contracts and more teams ship in parallel, our delivery systems need to scale with us, and we need someone who can own that evolution end to end, not just maintain what's already there.

**What you'll be working on**
-----------------------------

* Designing, building, and maintaining our CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) across microservices and Unity applications
* Building reusable pipeline templates so teams aren't reinventing the same workflow in every repo
* Weaving security into delivery itself: SAST/DAST, dependency and secret scanning, SBOM generation
* Making builds faster through smarter caching and parallelization
* Leveling up release automation: versioning, approvals, migrations, feature flags, release notes
* Partnering directly with engineers to improve their day-to-day: local dev parity, preview environments, PR checks, AI-assisted workflows
* Building real observability around pipelines and deployments, metrics, logs, alerts, dashboards that actually get looked at
* Being there when a deployment or release goes sideways
* Keeping an eye on the broader tooling landscape so our stack stays modern, not just familiar

**What makes this role different**
----------------------------------

Engineering here is flat. No tech leads, no layers between you and a decision. If you see a better way to build something, you build it, you don't pitch it up a chain and wait. And this isn't infrastructure in the abstract: the services you're supporting ship into robots working hospital floors, live shows choreographed across a city skyline, and holographic experiences built with an actual race team. You'll feel the difference

### **Meet Siena**

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

### **The team**

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

You take the hardest problems customers hit in production and solve them end to end: a webhook that stopped firing, an agent filling the wrong parameter, a report that won't reconcile. * Raise the team's floor. Lift what the whole team can resolve, not just what you can
* Know where your scope ends. Escalate genuine product bugs and outages with a clean reproduction, not a shrug
* Within 90 days, name the top recurring failure patterns and attack them at the root, not just patch symptoms

**At Mako, we believe in the power of collaboration to drive innovation in pursuit of our collective ambition; excellence in trading. Our diverse community is connected through a commitment to being the best we can be with the highest standards of integrity.**

We're looking for a Platform Engineer to help design, build, and operate our on-premises Kubernetes platform running on a self-managed Linux VM fabric (KVM/libvirt-based hypervisor layer). You'll own the infrastructure that sits beneath our application workloads — from the hypervisor and VM provisioning up through Kubernetes cluster lifecycle, networking, storage, and the golden-path tooling that application teams use to ship software.

This is a hands-on, deeply technical role for someone who enjoys operating infrastructure at the systems level — not a cloud-managed-service consumer role. The VM fabric itself is still being designed and built out, so you'll have real influence over its architecture, not just its day-to-day operation. You'll be responsible for keeping the fabric and the clusters running on top of it healthy, secure, and performant, without the safety net of a hyperscaler's managed control plane.

**What you'll be involved in:**

* Design the Linux VM fabric underpinning the platform from the ground up: hypervisor architecture (KVM/libvirt), host networking topology, storage backing for VM disks, and how the fabric will scale as workload demand grows
* Operate and maintain the hypervisor layer across multiple physical hosts, including host patching, live migration/evacuation, and failure response with minimal workload disruption
* Design and maintain a distributed shared storage system such as Ceph, or an alternative
* Design and maintain VM templating and golden-image pipelines so Kubernetes nodes are provisioned consistently and can be rebuilt or rotated on demand
* Automate the VM lifecycle end-to-end — provisioning, scaling, patching, decommissioning — via infrastructure-as-code
* Manage compute, memory, and storage capacity planning across the fabric, including host-level oversubscription strategy and headroom for node failure or maintenance
* Own virtual networking within the fabric — host networking, VLANs/overlay networks — and design how it hands off cleanly into the Kubernetes CNI layer above it
* Design, build, and maintain the full lifecycle of on-prem Kubernetes clusters: bootstrapping, version upgrades, node scaling, and decommissioning, using tooling such as kubeadm, C
